sidedata.h

The side data of a frame, in formats an app and the filters share: its noise (HDRG_SD_NOISE, the analysis's, given to the filters), its motion (HDRG_SD_MOTION: an app's or a filter's vectors) and its codec's film grain parameters (HDRG_SD_FILM_GRAIN: an app's, from its decoder). A session's frames take their motion and grain in these formats; video.h and filter.h include it.

Plugins describes how the filters read and write them.

Source: include/hdrgrading/sidedata.h

The header's own description

libhdrgrading — the side data of a frame: its noise (the analysis's, given to the filters), its motion (an app's or a filter's vectors) and its codec's film grain parameters (an app's, from its decoder). An app gives a session's frames their motion and grain in these formats; the filters read and write them (filter.h)

line 44

Side data of a frame (nego_side_data). HDRG_SD_NOISE, version HDRG_SD_NOISE_VERSION (1 while the ABI is not frozen): the input frame's noise and compression artifacts as HDRG_SD_NOISE_FLOATS floats, levels of its code values over the full scale (an 8-bit code is 1/255). Y', Cb, Cr apply the source's luminance coefficients to its code values.

  [0]       Y' over every level; < 0 = not measured (frame too small)
  [1] - [8] Y' of the levels in each eighth of [0, 1]; < 0 = too few
            samples
  [9], [10] Cb, Cr
  [11]      blockiness: Y' steps across the 8-pixel grid over those
            inside it, on the quieter areas, edges (steps over 12 8-bit
            codes) left out (1 = no block artifacts)
  [12]      block step: the mean |Y' step| across the grid minus the one
            inside it, on the same areas (0 = no block artifacts)
  [13]      ringing: in the grid's blocks with an edge, the mean
            |Y' - its 3x3 mean| of the samples away from the edge over
            the same in the blocks without one (1 = no ringing)
  [14]      ringing level: the first mean minus the second (0 = none)

line 68

HDRG_SD_MOTION, version HDRG_SD_MOTION_VERSION (1 while the ABI is not frozen): the motion of a frame's blocks, in the host's byte order: a hdrg_sd_motion_t, then its fields, each a hdrg_sd_motion_field_t followed by its grid_w x grid_h hdrg_sd_motion_block_t in rows. A field's vector v of the block at q (the frame's pixels) is the motion from frame t to frame t + ref_offset in quarter pixels: the content at q in frame t is at q + v there. An INTERP job's output (job_set_side_data) carries the motion between its two frames at its phase: ref_offset 1, the output's block at q reading the job's frame at q - phase v and the next one at q + (1 - phase) v (the session caps the gain of the output's blocks of low confidence with it). The app gives a session frame's (hdrg_session_frame_t.motion: a codec's, a game engine's): the frame's PREFILTER filters and its INTERP jobs read it (nego_side_data). A PREFILTER job's output (job_set_side_data) adds its fields to the frame's after the app's (HDRG_SD_MOTION_FIELDS at most, the app's first) for the frame's INTERP jobs and the session's output (not the PREFILTER filters after it): hdrg.mctf's, the motion to the frames of its window at phase 0.

line 126

HDRG_SD_FILM_GRAIN, version HDRG_SD_FILM_GRAIN_VERSION (1 while the ABI is not frozen): the film grain a codec carries as parameters its decoder did not add to the frame (FFmpeg's export_side_data=film_grain), in the host's byte order: a hdrg_sd_film_grain_t, then its kind's parameters. HDRG_FILM_GRAIN_AV1: a hdrg_sd_film_grain_av1_t, AV1's film grain synthesis (AFGS1's model) on the coded Y'CbCr the header describes. The app gives a session frame's (hdrg_session_frame_t.film_grain): the session puts the grain in the output as the source would have shown it in SDR (grain_policy PRESERVE and RESYNTH, in place of the grain its PREFILTER stage removed; REDUCE leaves it out).
